_comment: ARCH-MCP-CALL-PIPELINE-W1 CH3 — the tool-dispatch boundary, read by scripts/check-tool-dispatch-boundary.mjs.
Every tool call on every channel (MCP, x402 HTTP, okx.ai A2MCP, ACP) dispatches through `pipeline`. No other src/ file may
call an engine entry point (`engines`) or write a tool-call request_log row (`request_log` with a registered tool name,
names read from `registry`) unless it has a row in `allow` with a reason of at least 25 characters.
An unregistered call site FAILS the gate. An `allow` row that matches no call site ALSO fails it (stale exemption).
An engine module may call itself; the pipeline may call anything. Rows are keyed on file + symbol, never on a line number.
Seeded from the CH1 endpoint-truth audit §P3 (every engine call site outside its own module). Adding a row is a
decision that this call is NOT a caller-facing dispatch — write the reason as the evidence, not the intent.

allow.reason: The router IS the trade-call dispatch: the pipeline's get_trade_call / get_trade_signal / get_equity_call rows call routeTradeCall, which resolves assetClass and DEFAULT_PERP_TIMEFRAME once and then dispatches to the perp engine (P3).
The equity leg of the same router: a bare equity ticker or assetClass 'equity' reaches getEquityCall only through routeTradeCall, which the pipeline alone calls (P3).
Grid refresh scorer: internal:true, no caller, no license, no request_log row; feeds the HOLD-capture grid and the dashboard, never a channel response (P3 internal reuse).
scan_trade_calls cell scorer: internal:true per cell inside the ONE scan dispatch; the scan itself reaches the engine through the pipeline's scan_trade_calls row (P3 internal reuse).
Seeder CLI (shadow-signal cron), not a channel: runs as its own process with its own caller tag and writes the signals table, not request_log (P3 internal reuse).

Public website /api/search route — a web-UI endpoint, not a tool channel. The search_knowledge MCP tool dispatches through the pipeline's row; the site shares the engine so both search the same bundle.

Public website /api/chat route — web UI with the license resolved from the REQUEST (tests/unit/chat-rate-limit.test.ts), not a tool channel. The chat_knowledge MCP tool dispatches through the pipeline's row.

Health-probe CLI (the hourly pre-trade-health canary), not a channel: ONE engine call per run with the internal license under its own batch caller tag, in a read-only session; it writes no request_log row and bills no unit (DECISION-CALL-V1-W3 CH2).
